description: Returns how many MCP servers the Official MCP Registry lists, split by status (active, deprecated), remote transport (streamable-http, sse) and package type (npm, pypi, ...). Example output: {"unique_servers":53618,"by_status":{"active":52778,"deprecated":840}}. No arguments. Good for 'How many MCP servers are there, and how many run remotely?'.
name: registry_totals
